subject.title: fix(llm): summarize ephemeral tool results to preserve prefix cache

question: Should OpenClaw solve this regression by hiding selected tool-result contents in provider conversion, or should the fix stay limited to heartbeat/session-status isolation, pruning, or a provider-cache strategy that preserves normal tool outputs?
rationale: The submitted approach changes what the model can see after core tools run, so code inspection alone should not decide the permanent tool-result visibility policy.

options.title: Narrow the visibility policy first
options.body: Keep only low-value heartbeat/status outputs eligible for stable placeholders, rebase onto `packages/ai`, and require live DeepSeek proof before merge.

options.title: Prefer provider-cache work instead
options.body: Use the related prefix-cache strategy work to preserve cache boundaries without hiding ordinary tool outputs.

options.title: Accept broad summarization intentionally
options.body: Maintainership can choose the broad whitelist, but it should be documented and tested as a deliberate agent-behavior change.

recommendation.title: Narrow the visibility policy first
recommendation.body: Keep only low-value heartbeat/status outputs eligible for stable placeholders, rebase onto `packages/ai`, and require live DeepSeek proof before merge.
